svg.text: One row per species, target locus centred on a shared slot grid
Which annotated loci flank the target gene, in which transcription direction, and are the same neighbours present across species?

Loci are placed by annotated neighbour rank, not by genomic coordinate; the spacing carries no distance information. The arrowhead is the annotated transcription direction. Local synteny is supporting evidence for locus identity and
genomic context; it does not by itself establish isoform or event identity.

Species shown: 30 of 30 in this dataset · complete neighbourhood: Homo sapiens, Pan troglodytes, Gorilla gorilla gorilla, Pongo abelii, Macaca mulatta, Callithrix jacchus, Mus musculus, Rattus norvegicus, Oryctolagus cuniculus, Canis

lupus familiaris, Felis catus, Bos taurus, Sus scrofa, Equus caballus, Ovis aries, Monodelphis domestica, Ornithorhynchus anatinus, Gallus gallus, Meleagris gallopavo, Taeniopygia guttata, Anolis carolinensis, Alligator mississippiensis,

Chrysemys picta bellii, Xenopus tropicalis, Ambystoma mexicanum, Danio rerio, Oryzias latipes, Gasterosteus aculeatus, Takifugu rubripes, Oreochromis niloticus · partial: none · no neighbourhood available: none.
